title: QE custom evolution loops fail before WSL submission when execution manifest contains YAML date objects
description: Expected: QE custom evolution should normalize generated execution manifests and outbound workspace payloads into JSON-compatible primitives before submission. Actual: task qe_20260522_012542_90fb created 16 loop records but all failed locally before WSL submission with TypeError: Object of type date is not JSON serializable. PyYAML parses unquoted conf.yaml dates into datetime.date; execution_manifest preserves them and QEWorkspaceClient posts the payload without normalize_json().

trigger_condition.error: Object of type date is not JSON serializable

reproduce_command:
PYTHONPATH=F:\Dev\AIstock python - <<'PY'
import json
from backend.services.quantevolver.execution_manifest import _safe_conf_yaml_load, _artifact_manifest
text = '''
task:
  model: {class: LSTM, kwargs: {}}
  dataset:
    class: DatasetH
    kwargs: {handler: {kwargs: {}}}
port_analysis_config:
  strategy: {class: ScoreWeightedTopkStrategyV2, kwargs: {}}
  backtest:
    start_time: 2024-07-01
    end_time: 2026-04-27
    account: 10000000
  executor: {class: SimulatorExecutor}
'''
conf = _safe_conf_yaml_load(text)
manifest = {'artifact': _artifact_manifest(conf, {'label_horizon': 10, 'factor_list': ['x']})}
json.dumps({'config': {'execution_manifest': manifest}})
PY
required_verification: pytest regression for execution_manifest unquoted YAML dates returning JSON-compatible ISO strings
pytest regression for QEWorkspaceClient outbound payload normalize_json before httpx.post(json=payload)
python -m pytest backend/tests -k 'execution_manifest or workspace_client or quantevolver' -q -p no:cacheprovider
After backend restart, rerun one loop from qe_20260522_012542_90fb as smoke and confirm WSL job creation before rerunning all 16 loops
closure_requirements: Execution manifest returned from builder contains only JSON-compatible primitives for generated Qlib conf.yaml dates.
QEWorkspaceClient outbound payload is normalized before httpx JSON encoding.
The failure signature TypeError: Object of type date is not JSON serializable is covered by regression tests.
BUG-101 registry record and GitHub issue remain synchronized with fix branch, commit, and validation evidence.

events.note: Mirrored manually to GitHub issue #165 via gh CLI because Validation MCP sync is currently blocked by an unrelated UTF-8 BOM parse error in another BUG JSON registry entry.
Reported from qe_20260522_012542_90fb execution failure logs and DB loop records; 16/16 loops failed before WSL submission.

Two-layer defense: (1) execution_manifest.py build_and_audit_execution_manifest wraps all 3 return-path manifests with normalize_json() from qe_archive.models, converting datetime.date → .isoformat() at source. (2) qe_workspace_client.py create_and_run_loop applies normalize_json() on payload before httpx.post(json=payload) as defense-in-depth. Regression test (4 cases) added at backend/tests/quantevolver/test_execution_manifest_json_safe.py.
